target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, one vCPU, VirtIO input and WAV-backed virtio-sound-pci
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/psalmody-current-audio-recheck-2026-11-11.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-psalmody-current-audio-device-recheck-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-psalmody --probe-psalmody-audio-timer
verified: Psalmody opened, recording was enabled, and H entered a C5 note.
The WAV checker found C5 in two sustained 50 ms windows.
Shift+Escape exited playback, the graphical terminal evaluated 40+2 as 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.
The experimental audio timer delivered 8 IRQs.
scope_note: QEMU PCM generation and application interaction are verified on the current ISO; live UTM audible playback and broader song editing remain separate checks.
